tagline: International Association for Inland Waterway Transport Representation and Safety
hero_kpi_rationale: The organization welcomed 225 participants from 11 different countries at its 2024 annual congress (May 15-17 in Frankfurt), demonstrating its central role in representing and sharing knowledge within the European inland waterway transport sector.

kpis.name: Annual Congress Participation
kpis.explanation: Total number of participants from different countries attending the annual IVR Congress.
kpis.description: The 2024 annual congress took place from May 15 to 17, 2024 in Frankfurt am Main with 225 participants from 11 different European countries.
kpis.signal: Strong international participation demonstrating sector engagement

kpis.name: Number of Countries Represented
kpis.explanation: Number of different European countries represented by participants at the annual congress.
kpis.description: The 2024 congress brought together participants from 11 different European countries, consolidating IVR's international positioning.

kpis.name: Loss Prevention Colloquium Attendance
kpis.explanation: Number of participants attending the first IVR Loss Prevention Colloquium event.
kpis.description: The first edition of the Loss Prevention Colloquium took place on November 4, 2024 in Antwerp with approximately 80 participants from Belgium, the Netherlands and Germany.
kpis.signal: Strong attendance at inaugural loss prevention event with multi-country participation

kpis.name: Technical Sheets Published
kpis.explanation: Number of technical guidance documents and information sheets published by IVR committees to provide current and relevant information to the inland waterway sector.
kpis.description: Several new technical sheets and infographics were published during 2024, providing up-to-date and relevant information to the European inland navigation sector.
kpis.signal: Ongoing knowledge dissemination to the industry through technical infographics and guidance

kpis.name: Revenue
kpis.description: Revenue extracted from yfinance.income_stmt over the last 4 years. Metric tracked annually, historical values maintained over the past 4 years.
kpis.signal: Revenue of €7.81 Bn in the latest year

ai_positioning.summary: No mention of artificial intelligence or advanced AI technologies in the report. The organization focuses on safety, technical standardization, decarbonization, regulation and training within the European inland waterway transport sector.
evidence: No reference to AI, machine learning algorithms or advanced automation
Topics covered include vessel safety, incident prevention, decarbonization, technical standards (CESNI), regulation and job quality
Mentioned initiatives involve infographics, technical guidelines and standardization studies, with no AI component
